parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.

parameters.name: UploadId
parameters.description: The file upload task ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [UploadFile](~~2850466~~) operation to create an upload task, or by calling the [ListUploadTasks](~~2851127~~) operation to query existing tasks.
